name: Discipline Team
subtitle: Tasks and routines
description: Discipline for AltStore Classic. Tasks, routines, daily streaks, an opt-in iOS Guided Access single-app mode, AI photo verification, and support for English and German.

apps.name: Discipline
apps.subtitle: Tasks, routines, and focus
apps.localizedDescription: Manage tasks and recurring routines that reset reliably by calendar day, build a daily streak without freezes, opt into iOS Guided Access to lock the app while a task is active, verify tasks with AI photos, and customize the language, color scheme, and app icon. Guided Access must be enabled in iOS Settings first. Available in English and German.

versions.localizedDescription: Tasks can now be edited from task management, and the six-digit security PIN can be changed after verifying the current PIN. Includes PIN-based task completion and optional iOS Guided Access single-app mode.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Die Kamera nimmt das Abschlussfoto für die KI-Prüfung der Aufgabe auf.

news.title: Discipline 1.0.6: Edit Tasks and Change PIN
news.caption: Edit existing tasks and change your six-digit security PIN from task management.
